mentions.name: Lauselt
mentions.description: A microreading service that lets users get long books read in small chunks of time by opening the book where they left off and scrolling small chunks of text during 1-5 minute breaks. It features a Duolingo-style daily streak to build a daily reading habit, includes public domain Estonian books, and supports uploading your own book, which is automatically split into small chunks.
mentions.problem: It is hard to finish long books when only small chunks of free time are available during the day.
mentions.audience: People with only short 1-5 minute breaks (waiting for a bus, commercials, waiting for food) who want to finish long books
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a microreading service that let's me get long books read with small chunks of time that I have - https://lauselt.ee Currently I've added some public domain Estonian books in there
